representation: trajectory-centric registered ALOHA task-TCP 6D converted to G1 wrist by one fixed tool transform
source_position_frame: ALOHA task TCP derived from link-6 by the fixed authoritative link6-to-TCP transform
source_orientation_frame: ALOHA task TCP with one pooled static axis compatibility alignment per side

workspace_mapping_policy.method: metric episode-registered TCP pose followed only by fixed target-tool-to-G1-wrist coordinate conversion
workspace_mapping_policy.orientation_mapping: preserve registered source TCP orientation through one fixed axis compatibility transform
workspace_mapping_policy.outer_reach_fraction_reason: no representation-specific reach projection; infeasibility is handled by the common solver contract

hand_mapping: common semantic OPEN/PRESHAPE/GRASP/HOLD/RELEASE mapping shared byte-for-byte with B
whole_hand_policy: common target-embodiment Dex3 realization outside the spatial representation switch
